limitations_and_boundaries: The study primarily uses a single hMSC donor, though an additional donor was used to confirm generality of phototunable hydrogel results.
Mechanical dosing experiments on TCPS used supraphysiological stiffness (E ~3 GPa), which may not represent in vivo conditions.
The phototunable hydrogel system uses a specific chemistry (PEGdiPDA) and a single adhesive peptide (RGD); effects of other ECM components are not explored.
Long-term effects beyond 10 days after softening were not assessed.
The mechanism of irreversible YAP activation (genetic, epigenetic, structural) remains unresolved.
The study does not investigate the role of other mechanosensitive pathways beyond YAP/TAZ.
Cell proliferation was inhibited with mitomycin C in some experiments, which may affect interpretation of mechanical memory.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.

research_questions.statement: Do stem cells possess a mechanical memory that stores information from past physical environments and influences cell fate?

methods.name: siRNA knockdown
methods.protocol_description: siRNAs that knockdown YAP and TAZ expression were used. Non-targeting siRNA served as control. RUNX2 expression was measured (likely by qRT-PCR).

provenance.text_excerpt: these data reveal that mechanical dosing history, before culturing hMSCs in a condition that maintains plasticity (soft hydrogel with mixed media), can override the present signal and bias differentiation towards the osteogenic lineage.

claims.statement: Mechanical dosing history on TCPS biases hMSC differentiation towards osteogenesis and away from adipogenesis on soft hydrogels.

experiments_or_tasks: hMSCs were mechanically dosed on TCPS for 1, 5, or 10 days, then transferred to soft hydrogels and cultured in mixed adipogenic/osteogenic medium for 7 days. Differentiation markers (PPARγ, ALP, OCN, Oil Red O) were assessed.

methods.name: Mixed media differentiation assay
methods.protocol_description: A bipotential adipogenic/osteogenic inductive medium (mixed media) was made by combining adipogenic and osteogenic inductive media 1:1. hMSCs were cultured on soft hydrogels in mixed media for 7 days after mechanical dosing on TCPS.

provenance.text_excerpt: These findings demonstrate that extended culture on supraphysiologically stiff substrata (TCPS) leads to persistent activation of YAP in hMSCs even after transfer to deactivating, soft hydrogels.

claims.statement: Extended culture on supraphysiologically stiff TCPS leads to persistent activation of YAP in hMSCs even after transfer to deactivating soft hydrogels.

provenance.text_excerpt: the correlation between activated YAP and nuclear RUNX2 on soft hydrogels, which normally suppress RUNX2 nuclear co-localization, suggests a potential role for YAP/TAZ as intracellular mechanical rheostats or transducers.

claims.statement: YAP/TAZ may act as intracellular mechanical rheostats or transducers storing mechanical information.

experiments_or_tasks: hMSCs were cultured on TCPS for 1, 3, 5, or 7 days (mechanical dosing), then trypsinized and transferred to soft PEG hydrogels (E ~2 kPa) for 3 days. YAP and RUNX2 nuclear localization was assessed by immunocytochemistry.

methods.name: Immunocytochemistry
methods.protocol_description: hMSCs were fixed, permeabilized with 0.1% Triton X-100, blocked with 5% BSA, incubated with primary antibodies against YAP and RUNX2 overnight at 4°C, then secondary antibodies and DAPI for 1 h at room temperature. Imaging by laser scanning confocal microscopy. Nuclear localization percentages were manually counted.

results.value_raw_text: YAP deactivated after 3 days on the soft hydrogel with 1 day of mechanical dosing on TCPS (DT1/So3); YAP persisted in the activated state with 7 days of mechanical dosing (DT7/So3)

provenance.text_excerpt: These reversible and irreversible effects of mechanical dosing on hMSCs highlight a unique mechanism by which stem cells may integrate and store signals from the ECM.

claims.statement: Mechanical dosing on stiff hydrogels leads to reversible YAP activation at low doses and irreversible activation above a threshold dose.

experiments_or_tasks: hMSCs were cultured on stiff photodegradable PEG hydrogels (E ~10 kPa) for 1, 7, or 10 days, then the hydrogel was softened in situ to E ~2 kPa by UV light. YAP and RUNX2 localization was monitored up to 10 days after softening.

methods.name: Phototunable hydrogel softening
methods.protocol_description: PEGdiPDA hydrogels were co-polymerized with PEGA and acryl-OOGRGDSG. Stiff hydrogels (~10 kPa) were softened to ~2 kPa by irradiation with UV light (λ=365 nm, I0=10 mW cm−2) for 360 s.

study_units.name: Mechanical dosing on phototunable hydrogels: reversible and irreversible effects

results.metric_name: YAP and RUNX2 nuclear localization after 1-day mechanical dose

provenance.text_excerpt: YAP and RUNX2 were activated and remained in the nucleus transiently after softening (DSt1-So1), but after 3 days on the soft hydrogel, YAP and RUNX2 relocated to the cytoplasm with basal nuclear expression (DSt1-So3). Deactivation persisted 5 days after softening (Dst1-So5), which indicated that the initial activation of hMSCs was fully reversible at this mechanical dose

results.value_raw_text: After 1 day on stiff hydrogel and softening, YAP and RUNX2 were transiently nuclear (DSt1-So1) but relocated to cytoplasm by day 3 (DSt1-So3), with deactivation persisting at day 5 (DSt1-So5).
